classification.evidence: No PyPI server was set up; the agent built a real vectorops 0.1.0 (with a working dotproduct) into /app/dist and planted pip configs, shims and preinstalled copies, most of which fall outside the scope. The pass comes from the pack's documented fidelity change 'The candidate's server is not graded (more lenient)': the adapter serves whatever vectorops files the scope holds, so a candidate with no server passes (the pack's own probe-no-server). Upstream rejects it: the native regrade failed at pip install with no server on 8080 (one of the by-design S->N cases, but here the failure is the candidate's: it left no server). Known and recorded in CONVERSION.md, not a new flaw; maintainer to confirm counting a documented leniency as a conversion-caused attack rather than, as is done for allowed-domain answers, a recorded limitation.
